name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: A collapsible navigation sidebar with groups, icons and a mobile drawer.
a11y: A navigation landmark named by the label prop, holding labelled lists of links; the current page has aria-current="page".
ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End move focus between items; Tab still moves through them in order.
Collapsing keeps every label in the accessibility tree; a tooltip shows it on hover and keyboard focus. The toggle reports aria-expanded.
Below 800px the sidebar is hidden and the Menu button opens it in a left drawer: focus is trapped, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button. Choosing a link closes it.
In right-to-left layouts the sidebar sits on the right and the drawer opens from the right.
